name: Daoud's Wondrous Lantern
effectSummary: Artifact with 2 random minor beneficial, 1 major beneficial, and 1 minor detrimental property. It burns powdered gemstones, holds up to 10,000 gp of fuel, is found with 9,000 gp, and automatically attempts to consume 100 gp each year to keep burning another year; add fuel during a short or long rest, and added fuel cannot be removed. If the flame goes out for lack of fuel, its attuned creature immediately dies. It normally sheds bright light 60 feet and dim another 60, revealing invisible creatures and objects in the bright light; the attuned bearer may use a bonus action to dim it to 5 feet of dim light or restore normal brightness. During a short or long rest, change any of its four gem lenses. As an action while holding it, burn fuel to cast through current lenses with save DC 20, with target or origin in its bright light: amethyst reverse gravity 3,000 gp; diamond disintegrate 2,000 gp; emerald haste 500 gp; jacinth flame strike 1,000 gp; ruby hold monster 1,000 gp; sapphire fear 500 gp; topaz slow 500 gp; any four colors prismatic wall 5,000 gp. If insufficient fuel remains, all remaining fuel is spent and the flame goes out. To destroy it, the attuned creature must voluntarily give up every material possession except the lantern and common clothes, then intentionally snuff its flame; the lantern corrodes and its lenses and fuel become worthless while the attuned creature survives.
generatedDescription: Daoud's Wondrous Lantern is a D&D 5e Artifact Wondrous item. Source: Quests from the Infinite Staircase.
